name: Beer
summary: A commonly consumed recreational drink, Brewed from edible grains and refined to taste. Its effects are doubtless enjoyable, but can easily catch up with the drinker.
effects: Tier_1, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_2 Edible

attrs.Effects: For the Duration, you become Stunned, immune to the effects of Strain up to 3, and Vulnerable.

text: Tier_1, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_2 Edible
effect: Tier_1, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_2 Edible

name: Tippling
summary: Highly refined alcohol, almost to the point of purity, infused with the otherwise poisonous Demon's Tongue fungus. Going down with a notable tinge of sulfur, Tippling is a frequent refuge for the over-weary in need of forgetting.
effects: Tier_1, Active_1 Hours/1 Week, Addictive_3 Deadly_5 EDIBLE

attrs.Effects: For the Duration, you lose all the benefits of your Skill Ranks (while retaining your Feats.) When this Ends, roll 1d6 Chaos Dice. You shed 1 Corruption unless your roll a 6, in which case you suffer 1 Corruption.
attrs.Withdrawal: Unless you ingest a half Dose of Tippling, you suffer 3 Permament Strain until Recovery.

text: Tier_1, Active_1 Hours/1 Week, Addictive_3 Deadly_5 EDIBLE
effect: Tier_1, Active_1 Hours/1 Week, Addictive_3 Deadly_5 EDIBLE

name: Hunter's Tea
summary: Pressed from the Arrow Leaf, this milky decoction is well known for its ability to relieve fatigue and sharpen the senses. Higher concentrations are desirable to many, despite the bitter taste, as frequent consumption easily leads to dependency.
effects: Tier_T, Active_1 Turn/1 Day, Addictive_2, Edible

attrs.Withdrawal: You suffer a penalty to your Reflex, equal to your Tier.

text: Tier_T, Active_1 Turn/1 Day, Addictive_2, Edible
effect: Tier_T, Active_1 Turn/1 Day, Addictive_2, Edible

name: Fury
summary: When Demon's Tongue fungus is processed in the digestion of grazing Nassus, the vapors produced have strange effects on the mind. In spite of the qualms most have about the practice, none deny that Fury driven warriors are a fearsome foe.
effects: Tier_3, Active_1 Minute/1 Hour, Deadly_10 Addictive_2, Inhalent

attrs.Effects: You shed 3 Strain per Turn, and become Frenzied for the Duration.
attrs.Overdose: You become Frenzied and can Ignore Strain up to 3 for the Duration, falling Unconscious instantly when this Ends.
attrs.Withdrawal: You make all Potence and Vitality Tests with a Bane, and suffer one additional Chaos Die to Panic Risk.

text: Tier_3, Active_1 Minute/1 Hour, Deadly_10 Addictive_2, Inhalent
effect: Tier_3, Active_1 Minute/1 Hour, Deadly_10 Addictive_2, Inhalent

name: Pipeweed
summary: The bitter leaf of the Noumis Tree, either smoked or eaten directly. These are a frequent refuge of scholars, especially Mages willing to feed an addiction for the edge which Pipeweed can lend to thought.
effects: Tier_1, Active_1 Hour/1 Week, Addictive_6, Edible

attrs.Effects: Your Mind is increased by 1, and your Mind Skills are one greater for Activities. Pipeweed Addicts have permenantly stained lips and fingers, dyed a shade of red easily mistaken for blood.
attrs.Withdrawal: You suffer a penalty to your Mind, equal to twice your Tier.

text: Tier_1, Active_1 Hour/1 Week, Addictive_6, Edible
effect: Tier_1, Active_1 Hour/1 Week, Addictive_6, Edible

name: Bitterblack Unguent
summary: Heavily reduced sap from the Noumis Tree. This oily dark liquid is prized for its ability to stave of rots and other sickness. Though most rue its use for the sharp sting of touching it to flesh.

attrs.Effects: When placed on an Infected Injury, roll 1d6 Chaos Dice. On a roll of 3 or less the Infection is dispelled.

name: Bellsberry Ointment
summary: Bright pink, a mixture of dairy fats and Bellsberries, Barbers prize this ointment for its effect on burns.

attrs.Effects: When applied to a Burn, this dispels the Persistant Strain caused by that Injury for the Duration.

name: Moralsop
summary: Fabric enclosing a dried Deathling blossom, little black and white flowers that grow near graves. Moralsop has no effects on Verdun, but is a powerful ward against diseases.

attrs.Effects: While breathing through the fabric, you cannot contract an airborn illness.

name: Shade
summary: Nectar of the Nightbloom flower, Shade is a quick, painless killer with a reputation as a method of suicide.
effects: Tier_2, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_10, Contact, Edible

attrs.Effects: A feeling of numbness fills you, making you Off_Balance.
attrs.Overdose: You fall Unconcious and die within 10 Minutes.

text: Tier_2, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_10, Contact, Edible
effect: Tier_2, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_10, Contact, Edible

name: Diablerie
summary: Purified concentrate of the Demon's Tongue mushroom. This crimson powder is a violently lethal toxin to nearly anything living and leaves a gruesome trace of its presence in victims.
effects: Tier_3, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_17, Edible

attrs.Effects: A wash of rage floods your mind, your eyes turn as red as the lakes of hell, and bloody slaver drips madly from your lips. You become Frenzied for the Duration, always suffering the effects of a rolled 6. At the end of this duration, roll 1d6 Chaos Dice, dying instantly on face 6. If you survive this, you become Unholy, suffer 6 Corruption instantly, and as much as a permenant increase to your Mind. The visual effects on your eyes and saliva are permenant, and if you ever consume this again, you die instantly.
attrs.Overdose: As above, but you die at the end of the duration. Diablerie does not have a instantly lethal dosage, subjecting all victims to its hour of insanity.

text: Tier_3, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_17, Edible
effect: Tier_3, Active_1 Hour/1 Day, Deadly_17, Edible

name: Ikthein Tincture
summary: Adaptability is a function of forgetting. The Shard Sea demands Expeditioners be persistent, changeable, and able to continuously evolve. Consequently, they've also learned to Forget. The Ikthein Tincture is one of the most effective means, and allows one to adapt that much faster.

attrs.Effects: After consuming an Ikthein Tincture, you are instantly rendered Unconscious for 12 Hours. Within this Duration, you experience a dream state that represents your current Abilities, Skills, and Training in a surreal landscape of abstractions and half-logical connections. While in this state, you can Forget.
